verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows in Kino. Cloud agents editing "while you're away" are one-off delegated actions, not a recurring schedule. Smart bins that "fill as footage arrives" are an adjacent auto-updating filter, not scheduled workflows. A community user making recurring podcasts reported missing reuse and template capabilities rather than any scheduling feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
